events.name: Montreal Canadiens at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Alexandre Texier broke a tie 1:06 into the third period and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 3-2 on Wednesday night to take a 3-2 lead in the first-round series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texier breaks 3rd-period tie, Canadiens beat Lightning 3-2 in Game 5 to take series lead

headlines.description: — Cam York flicked a wrist shot from the point, chucked his stick into the stands and chased away years of bad hockey in Philadelphia.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cam York scores in OT as Flyers beat Penguins 1-0 in Game 6, reach Round 2

events.name: Utah Mammoth at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Brett Howden scored a short-handed goal at 5:28 of the second overtime Wednesday night to give Vegas a 5-4 victory over the Utah Mammoth and put the Golden Knights one victory...
headlines.shortLinkText: Howden's short-handed goal gives Golden Knights 5-4 double-OT win over Mammoth and 3-2 series lead
